vetSays.line: 🛡️ Niamh, the person in their 60s, with a shaved head, the barber, Reagan and the person in their 60s, with a broad frame met them at the door — 4 put down. Niamh, the person in their 60s, with a shaved head, the barber, Reagan are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Reagan and Ava met them at the door — 2 put down. Reagan, Ava are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Greta just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Colleen just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fulvio just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Colleen, Reagan, Ayan, Fulvio and Emma met them at the door — 4 put down. Ayan didn't come back. Reagan, Fulvio, Emma are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ines just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dale just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ping just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Grace, Caleb and Ping met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Grace, Caleb are hurt.

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ping just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Caleb, Dale and Ping met them at the door — 3 put down. Caleb, Dale, Ping are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dale just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Caleb just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

regDeaths.name: stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
stripes flowing where no wind blows
a soft green glow under the water
